messages:
emma: hey folks, day 0 orientation q — where should i post the following: laptop delivery tracking, badge/access request, desk photo for seating chart, calendar invites ive been sent, and a note about my keyboard preference? also how do i opt into the onboarding reminders?
dylan: welcome emma! quick map: laptop tracking & photos -> #new-hires (keep everything in-thread so it's searchable). badge/access -> #people-ops or ping @sarah directly. desk/photo for seating chart -> #facilities. calendar invites/questions about orientation -> DM the organizer or post in #new-hires if you think others need the same info. keyboard/ergonomic requests -> #facilities with header "ergonomics".
emma: good call on searchable threads. any channel etiquette we should follow? gifs ok? :D
leo: gifs are fine in #random but keep #new-hires focused. etiquette pointers: 1) use threads for troubleshooting or multi-message back-and-forth, 2) prefer reactions (:thumbsup:) instead of +1 messages, 3) avoid @channel unless truly org-wide, 4) redact secrets before posting.
devex-bot: Automated onboarding helpers available. To enable reminders: 1) run `/onboard enroll` to start the DM checklist, or 2) go to https://intranet.redwood/onboarding and toggle "Reminders". Use `/onboard prefs frequency daily` to change cadence. (bot)
emma: solid. where do i file a request if the laptop arrives with a boot loop / imaging error?
dylan: post in #eng-infra with this template so we can triage quickly:
```
- device serial: ABCD-1234
- model: Lenovo ThinkPad / MacBook Pro
- symptom: e.g., kernel panic, boot loop, stuck on apple logo
- logs/screenshots: attach photo or paste console output
- steps tried: e.g., reflashed, different cable, rebooted
- timezone & availability for swap:
```
Tag @eng-oncall if it's blocking your first-week tasks.
sarah: for badge & building access include full office location, manager name, and preferred floor. If you need same-day entry, add "URGENT: same-day access" to the form and DM me. Form: https://forms.redwood/badge-request
emma: what about security/privacy questions? where to ask about MFA or corporate machine image?
leo: security & MFA -> #eng-security (or security@redwood for sensitive issues). Do not post screenshots of MFA codes or recovery tokens in any channel. For exceptions to default image policies (e.g., needing additional dev tools) request via #eng-infra and cc your manager so we can log approvals.
emma: thanks! last tiny thing: sticker & swag requests where?
dylan: stickers & swag -> #random (there's a pinned swag request form) or DM people-ops. If you're remote, include your postal address in the form (don't post it in-channel).
emma: perfect, i've enrolled with the bot and submitted the badge form. appreciate the quick guide :smile:
dylan: welcome aboard emma! feel free to ping any of us in this thread if something trips up.
leo: one final note: when you post troubleshooting logs, trim long stack traces and use gist or pastebin links for very large dumps. keeps channels readable.
emma: will do, thanks everyone :tada:
